meta.data_description_zh:

報檔(H_BHP_CRSSC)中之每一大腸直腸癌患者在癌症登記檔(包
括長表 LF、短表SF 和TCDB)及健保檔、死因統計合併檔，共 14
個資料檔之所有資訊。另外也附上大腸癌篩檢檔，以便串聯大腸直

meta.data_description_en: The colorectal cancer cohort database includes all information from every colorectal cancer patient recorded in the 1979-2022 Cancer Registry Report (H_BHP_CRSSC), including detailed records in the long form LF, short form SF, and TCDB, as well as claims data and death certificate combined files. It also includes a colon cancer screening file for integrated use with the colorectal cancer cohort database.
